channel.title: Winston and Saffron
channel.description: Winston (a grumpy blue gorilla) and Saffron (a fairy librarian) co-host a show about the things their executive producer Luke is into: deep-dives on MCDM's survival-horror dungeon crawler Crows: Fortune or Death, and Mostly Correct, a weekly quiz show built from the week's news, grammar lessons, and Luke's life. Episodes are hosted on the Internet Archive; this feed is the show's own.
channel.itunes:author: Winston and Saffron

item.title: Monsters of Playtest 3
item.description: Winston and Saffron open the Playtest 3 bestiary in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death — six monster families from blood creatures to angels, demons, plants, undead and one-of-a-kind uniques, the letter system and encounter tables that scale from swarming A creatures to single apex horrors, and the likes and hates a clever crow can use to bait, distract or escape instead of fighting. Music: "Feral Chase" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

item.title: Magic and Chaos
item.description: Winston and Saffron deep-dive spellcasting in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death (Public Playtest 3) — how a casting test works, chaos rolls that grow more likely and more severe with spell rank, the backlash table from donkey head and polka accordion to frog and portal to Hell, and what it all means for Vang, the Conjurer at Luke's table, still waiting for his first dungeon casting at the Blood Library door. item.title: The Verdant Creche

item.title: Session One: Caw Caw
item.description: Winston and Saffron open Crows deep-dive Run 2 with an affectionate after-action on Luke's first session — character creation in Caw Caw, the mesa-top village of goats and festivals, two days' travel past the bypassed Ruined Tower, Yaxel's two Cruelty effects, and a party standing at the Blood Library door. item.title: Mostly Correct — November 1, 2026
item.description: Mostly Correct — November 1, 2026. Winston hosts, Saffron contests, and Luke executive-produces the first regular weekly edition of the quiz built entirely from the week just ended (Monday October 26 to Sunday November 1, 2026). Round one draws five questions from stories that actually ran in this week's Saffron Wire — the midterm-record fifty-two million early votes, the Spain train crash report, the Yerevan Pathway biodiversity deal, the one hundred thirteen port dockworkers strike, and a "which one really ran" Onion closer (the king-sized mattresses were real). Round two draws five questions from this week's daily grammar lessons — to/too/two, accept/except, I versus me, fewer/less with the maintenance spelling trap, and the long-running principal versus principle rivalry. Round three draws five affectionate questions from Luke's life this week — Winston's one-week review (he stays, bright grass-green, meaner until November 7), the Sunday steps goal locked at three thousand four hundred thirty-nine, Friday's recycling-Walmart-walk-Crows-prep order, tonight's single Blood Library round on Roll20, and Meg's November third birthday bathroom gift. A five-question lightning round mixes all three sources. Saffron's final score: eleven out of twenty under Winston's dubious scoring (thirteen correct raw, minus the waistcoat incident and the serenity tax; her appeal was heard and denied). The prize, as ever, is Winston's voice on her voicemail. Music: "Happy Happy Game Show" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ Audience sounds: Applause — "Clapping hurray", Wikimedia Commons, Public domain. Laughter — "approx-800-laughter-and-clapter-1" by lonemonk, Wikimedia Commons, licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0.

item.title: The Blood Library
item.description: Winston and Saffron close the Crows mini-series with the Blood Library in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death (Public Playtest 3) — Craelin's flesh-covered library, the blood lake and its rising encounter number, the Prison Crystal, the packet's pregens at 4th, 7th and 10th level, and the game-day plan for Luke's first run tonight: character creation, village, travel, and one Blood Library round. Episode 5 of the Oct 28–Nov 1 Crows mini-series. item.title: Crows: Fortune or Death — An Overview
item.description: Winston and Saffron give a full overview of MCDM's survival-horror dungeon crawler Crows: Fortune or Death — the fortune-or-death bargain, the village-travel-dungeon loop, Playtest Three rules, the dungeons, and played impressions from executive producer Luke ahead of his first run on November first. This is the bumpered edition, with the show's theme bumper. item.title: Winston and Saffron: The Handover
item.description: The first episode. Winston — deep-voiced, gruff, and mildly put-upon — meets his co-host Saffron, and the two of them work out, live on air, how this show is going to go. Executive producer: Luke.
